issues.description: The template's Lecture constructor signature only takes three parameters (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents) while the problem statement/UML and the solution expect a constructor that initializes all five attributes (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors) in that order. This mismatch prevents students from implementing the constructor as specified by the exercise and following the UML.
issues.suggestedFix: Modify the template Lecture constructor to accept and initialize all five attributes in the UML-specified order: (String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors). Update the constructor body to assign these parameters to the corresponding fields.
